MELE Discord Rich Presence - install notes

What it does
------------
Shows Discord presence while playing Mass Effect: Legendary Edition:
  - the game being played (ME1 / ME2 / ME3)
  - main menu vs. exploring a location
  - session playtime timer
Requires the Discord desktop app to be running while you play.

What you need installed first
-----------------------------
The MELE ASI loader (a bink2w64.dll proxy). If you get games from Steam/EA app
and use ME3Tweaks Mod Manager (M3), the loader is installed for you:
  M3 -> Mod Management -> ASI Mod Manager -> "install loader"
If you already installed ALOT or other ASI mods, you already have the loader.

Manual install
--------------
1. Copy MELEDiscordRPC.asi into each game's Binaries\Win64 folder you want
   presence for:
     Mass Effect Legendary Edition\Game\ME1\Binaries\Win64\
     Mass Effect Legendary Edition\Game\ME2\Binaries\Win64\
     Mass Effect Legendary Edition\Game\ME3\Binaries\Win64\
2. Copy MELEDiscordRPC.ini next to the .asi file in the same folder.
3. In the ini, set client_id= to your Discord application ID (number).
4. Launch the game with Discord running. A status appears under your name.

Uninstall
---------
Delete MELEDiscordRPC.asi (and the .ini) from the game folder(s).

Troubleshooting
---------------
- Logs: %LOCALAPPDATA%\MELEDiscordRPC\
- Set debug=1 in the ini for an on-screen console while the game runs.
- If nothing shows: confirm Discord desktop is running, confirm client_id is
  correct, and check the log for pattern-scan failures (rare; only if BioWare
  ever patches the game).
